source: English voice (US PlayStation release), transcribed by whisper.cpp large-v3

lines.text: Oh... Has it finally stopped? I thought we were goners for sure.
That was nothing. Look at me. I'm fine.
Show off. For all that money you spent on it,
you'd think this flying washtub of yours would have held up better.
Well, accidents happen. If we were ready for them,
we wouldn't call them accidents, would we?
How come those old fogies are so chipper, huh?
My stomach feels like it's been through a washing machine spin cycle.
